content: Official Teal and Huntr product pages independently position a personal job tracker around saving job details, organizing applications by stage, storing notes and tailored documents, tracking interview activity, and giving job seekers follow-up or progress cues. These are comparison evidence from vendor product claims, not independent adoption or user research. Jobot already supports discovery, a status pipeline, notes, editable AI cover letters/resume bullets, and job descriptions; interview scheduling, reminders, contact management, one-click browser capture, and job-seeker progress metrics are not evidenced in current Jobot workflows.
